batch: S10 brand: halftone sphere replaces the solid orb in the product mark and the favicon (ADR-077 amendment 1)
kind: Presentation only. Code-only, no migration, no auth, data, money or event change. Owner decision 9 Nov 2026 quoted in docs/adr/0077-corridra-visual-identity.md.
headNote: The exact head is the last commit of the PR; a file cannot hold its own commit hash. Quote the head from the PR and from the CI run.

commands.command: node scripts/gate.mjs docs-tests -- pnpm test:docs (includes tests/brand-identity.test.mjs, 5 of 5 pass)
pnpm exec vitest run tests/integration/navigation-v1-public-header.test.ts (6 of 6 pass)
pnpm build (apps/web, twice: before and after the 430 px wordmark rule)
pnpm test:ux --trace off against the production build (85 passed)

rendered: Production build served; public home at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 px: no horizontal overflow, mark box 46 x 44 px, brand link 44 px tall.

Header rows before and after on the production build: 320 and 360 px wrap to two rows as before (89 px); 390 px and wider stay one row (72 px) after the 14 px wordmark rule at 430 px and below; without that rule 390 px wrapped to 89 px.
Footer wordmark (reversed on navy) rendered at 1440 px: dots legible.
Favicon files rendered at 3x: favicon-16 orb tile, favicon-32, -48 and -64 halftone tile.

changedArtwork.icon.svg: halftone mark reversed on the navy tile, 0.92 of the tile, 21812 bytes
changedArtwork.favicon.ico: 16 px entry unchanged (orb); 32 and 48 px entries rasterised from icon.svg
changedArtwork.docs/brand/assets/favicon: favicon.svg, favicon-32, -48, -64 and favicon.ico replaced; favicon-16 unchanged; apple, android and maskable files were already the halftone mark and are unchanged

notDone: Signed-in headers and the left rail were not rendered here (they need a signed-in session); the CSS sizes were set to 46 x 44 inside the 64 px bar and 68 px collapsed rail and the 85 route UX gate passes. Please check them in the preview.
Open Graph and Twitter images already use the halftone lockup (checked by eye); not regenerated.
Browser tab at 16 CSS px on a 1x screen uses icon.svg (halftone) in browsers that prefer SVG; only favicon.ico keeps the orb at 16 px.
Trademark check, legal handoff and tagline review stay open.
